transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?
I guess… my eating’s been off. Some days I just forget lunch altogether, and other days I’m standing there eating crackers or sweets even though it doesn’t really taste right. It’s been bothering me.
Have you lost a significant amount of weight recently?
I don’t really know about the weight… I haven’t been keeping track. It’s more that my eating’s been strange—forgetting lunch some days, then picking at crackers or sweets when nothing tastes right.
Do you find that you're less interested in food than you used to be?
Maybe… yes. I don’t think about food the same way. Some days I forget lunch completely, and other days I’m just picking at crackers or sweets even though it doesn’t taste like much.
Are you afraid of gaining weight?
No… I don’t think that’s it. I’m not really worried about gaining weight. It’s more just… I don’t pay much attention to eating sometimes.
Do you avoid eating because of concerns or thoughts about the food itself?
I’m not sure… not really because of the food itself. I just don’t think much about it sometimes.
Do you feel like your lack of interest in food is related to your mood or how you're feeling emotionally?
Yes… I think so. Most mornings I wake up feeling heavy and low, like the day’s already gone dull before I even get dressed. Food just doesn’t matter much then.
Do you ever feel like you've lost control while eating?

Sometimes, I guess. Not like I’m really hungry… I’ll just stand there eating crackers or sweets, and it feels like I’m not quite choosing it. Other days I forget lunch altogether. Nothing tastes very right either way.
Do you think you would enjoy food more if your mood were better?

Maybe… I don’t know. I think if I felt better, food might seem more normal again. Lately it’s just all mixed up—some days I forget lunch, other days I’m eating crackers or sweets at the counter, and none of it tastes like much.
Do you usually eat those crackers or sweets when you're feeling particularly low or upset?

Yes… usually when I’m feeling low, I think. My eating’s just gotten turned around. Some days I miss lunch completely, and other days I’m at the counter eating crackers or sweets even though it doesn’t really taste right.
Are you eating those crackers or sweets as a way to try to feel better when you're low?

Maybe… I don’t know if I’m doing it to feel better exactly. It’s just my eating’s been all turned around. Some days I forget lunch, and other days I’m standing there eating crackers or sweets even though nothing really tastes right.
Do you think eating those crackers or sweets helps you feel a little better when you're low?

Maybe a little, but not really. It’s more like… I’m just standing there eating them because my meals are all off. Some days I don’t eat lunch at all, and other days it’s crackers or sweets, but they don’t taste right anyway.
Are you eating when you're not hungry as a way to try and improve your mood?

I don’t know that I’m doing it to improve my mood, exactly. It’s more that my eating is all mixed up… some days I forget lunch, and other days I’m just at the counter eating crackers or sweets, even though they don’t really taste right.
Do you think you eat crackers or sweets when you're feeling low as a way to cope with those feelings?
I don’t know if I’d call it coping. My eating’s just been… off. Some days I miss lunch completely, and other days I’m there eating crackers or sweets, but nothing really tastes right.
Do you think eating helps you deal with feeling low?
Not really. I mean… my eating is just all turned around. Some days I forget lunch completely, and other days I’m just standing there eating crackers or sweets, even though nothing tastes right.
Do you usually eat more when you're feeling low?

Sometimes, I guess. It’s not always tied to feeling low… my eating just gets mixed up. Some days I skip lunch without meaning to, and other days I’m standing there eating crackers or sweets even though they don’t really taste like much.
Do you think you would eat differently if you weren't feeling low?

Maybe. I’m not sure. It’s just… when I’m feeling low, my eating gets all turned around. Some days I forget lunch, and other days I’m just at the counter eating crackers or sweets, even though nothing really tastes right.
Do you think eating crackers or sweets is something you do specifically to try and make yourself feel less low?

I don’t know if it’s to make me feel better, exactly. It’s more like my eating’s just been off… some days I forget lunch, and other days I’m just there eating crackers or sweets, even though they don’t taste like much.
Do you think eating crackers or sweets has anything to do with trying to change how you're feeling?

Maybe not to change it exactly. It’s just… my eating’s been all turned around. Some days I forget lunch completely, and other days I’m standing there eating crackers or sweets even though nothing tastes right.
Do you think you eat crackers or sweets as a way to directly influence how you're feeling?

Not directly, no. It’s more that my eating is just… off. Some days I miss lunch without meaning to, and other days I’m at the counter eating crackers or sweets, even though they don’t really taste like anything.
Do you think eating crackers or sweets is something you do because you believe it will improve your mood?

No… I don’t really think of it like that. It’s more that my eating’s gotten all turned around. Some days I forget lunch, and other times I’m just eating crackers or sweets even though they don’t taste right.
